title: StatusSnapshot
description: What GET /api/status returns, and the shape of the page's build-time snapshot. Every section carries the time it was measured: a section whose source failed keeps its last good values with their old time, and the page falls back for that section alone.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: The public-host probes over the window [from, to]: up to 30 days, shorter while the history is younger.

checks.description: Every check of every host in the window.

hosts.description: Every probed host, in name order. The page chooses which it shows.

passedPercent.description: The share of passed checks, rounded down to two decimals, so 100 means no check failed.

offsiteCopy.title: OffsiteCopy
offsiteCopy.description: How far the offsite copy of the database (the WAL archive) fell behind over the window [from, to].

maxLagSeconds.description: The longest time since the last archived segment, rounded up to whole seconds.

drill.title: Drill
drill.description: The newest restore drill: the offsite backup restored into a throw-away database and every database checked.

restoreSeconds.description: From the start of the restore until the restored database was ready; null when a failed drill never got there.
